parrafo.es: Guru Movers atiende mudanzas residenciales y comerciales en Plantation y el área de Fort Lauderdale. Alex y su equipo envuelven y protegen cada mueble, y te dan una cotización justa y detallada antes de empezar, sin cargos ocultos.
parrafo.en: Guru Movers handles residential and commercial moves across Plantation and the Fort Lauderdale area. Alex and his team wrap and protect every piece of furniture, and give you a fair, detailed quote before you start, no hidden costs.

hero.imagen_alt: Guru Movers company truck with the owner Alex waving from the window, Plantation FL

parrafo_1.es: Guru Movers es una empresa de mudanzas de Plantation, FL, liderada por Alex y su equipo. Trabajamos mudanzas residenciales y comerciales, y llegamos incluso con poco aviso cuando el cliente nos necesita de última hora.
parrafo_1.en: Guru Movers is a moving company out of Plantation, FL, led by Alex and his team. We handle residential and commercial moves, and we show up even on short notice when a client needs us at the last minute.

parrafo_2.es: Nuestro trabajo se nota en el detalle: cada mueble se envuelve y protege antes de subirlo al camión, y la cotización se entrega por escrito, clara y sin sorpresas, antes de mover nada.
parrafo_2.en: Our work shows in the detail: every piece of furniture gets wrapped and protected before it goes on the truck, and the quote is handed over in writing, clear and with no surprises, before anything gets moved.

texto.es: Nos llamas y nos cuentas de tu mudanza. Te damos una cotización justa y detallada por escrito, sin cargos ocultos.
texto.en: You call us and tell us about your move. We give you a fair, detailed quote in writing, with no hidden costs.

texto.es: Elegimos fecha y hora, incluso si es de último momento: Guru Movers está disponible las 24 horas.
texto.en: We pick a date and time, even on short notice: Guru Movers is available around the clock.

texto.es: Alex y su equipo envuelven y protegen cada mueble y caja antes de subirlos al camión.
texto.en: Alex and his team wrap and protect every piece of furniture and box before it goes on the truck.

texto.es: Tus cosas llegan a su nuevo destino tal como salieron, sin daños.
texto.en: Your things arrive at the new place exactly as they left, with no damage.

nota.es: Cada mudanza se cotiza según el volumen y la distancia. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every move is quoted based on size and distance. Call us and we will walk you through the details, no strings attached.

texto.es: De un apartamento a una casa, o entre ciudades. Nos ocupamos de todo el proceso, desde el primer mueble hasta la última caja.
texto.en: From an apartment to a house, or across town. We handle the full process, from the first piece of furniture to the last box.

texto.es: Oficinas y locales. Coordinamos horarios que no interrumpan tu operación.
texto.en: Offices and businesses. We coordinate schedules that do not get in the way of your operation.

texto.es: Envolvemos y protegemos cada pieza antes de moverla, para que llegue intacta a su nuevo lugar.
texto.en: We wrap and protect every piece before it moves, so it arrives intact at its new place.

texto.es: ¿Llamaste y necesitas mudarte ya? Estamos disponibles las 24 horas para resolverlo.
texto.en: Called us and need to move right away? We are available 24 hours a day to make it happen.

pie.es: ¿Tienes una mudanza fuera de lo común? Llámanos igual, lo resolvemos.
pie.en: Have a move that does not fit the usual mold? Call us anyway, we will figure it out.

items.quote: This was my second time using Guru Movers, and they were just as amazing as the first. Alex, the owner, is truly the best - so friendly, patient, and professional.

From start to finish, Guru Movers exceeded my expectations! I'm absolutely thrilled with the service provided by Alex and his team. My move was stress-free thanks to their efficient and friendly team.
I must say Guru Movers are hands down the BEST moving company in Florida. Alex and his team are professionals and takes pride in their work.
